note: Priority queue. priority = gate severity (P0>P1>P2) × blast radius × evidence strength. The loop pulls the top OPEN, non-blocked item each iteration. New work is appended from: red gates, adversarial disproofs, shrunk property counterexamples, surviving mutants, coverage-ratchet misses, and (when dry) fresh audit rounds. See LOOP.md §5.

items.title: MCP create-recurring-appointment is NON-ATOMIC: a mid-series conflict leaves earlier occurrences committed while returning 'nothing created'
items.notes: $transaction is INSIDE the per-occurrence loop, so occurrences 1..N-1 commit then N throws → orphaned confirmed appointments + misleading error. Sibling recurring.ts:109 + v1 recurring route wrap the whole loop in ONE tx. Fix: hoist a single $transaction around the loop (mirror recurring.ts).

items.title: Recurring series drift 1h across a DST boundary (date-fns addWeeks/addMonths not tz-anchored)
items.notes: addWeeks/addMonths hold the UTC time-of-day constant on a UTC host, so a 9AM weekly series shifts to 10AM salon-local after DST (or gets rejected if pushed past close). Fix: advance on the salon wall clock via TZDate/@date-fns/tz (already a dep; see zoned-time.ts).

items.title: MCP create-recurring adds a fixed-ms interval → DST drift; 'monthly' = flat 30 days (always wrong)
items.notes: current = new Date(current.getTime() + intervalDays*86400000). Weekly drifts 1h across DST like L-025; monthly=30d drifts off the calendar date every occurrence. Fix: add calendar weeks/months in the salon IANA zone; use addMonths for monthly.

items.title: Existing appointments' turnover buffer (bufferAfter / staff bookingBuffer) is not reserved → back-to-back slots offered
items.notes: getAvailability blocks only [start,end] of existing appts; the buffered footprint applies only to the NEW slot. So when bufferAfter+staffBuffer>bufferBefore the configured turnover silently vanishes and two services book back-to-back with 0 gap. Fix: fetch each existing appt's bufferBefore/bufferAfter and pad its blockedRange.

items.title: Illegal appointment status transitions unguarded in updateAppointmentStatus + v1 PATCH + MCP cancel (complete→cancelled, revert completed, double check-in)
items.notes: /api/bookings/[id] enforces getValidStatusTransitions (terminal states have no outgoing), but the server action, v1 PATCH default branch, MCP cancel-appointment, and v1 DELETE do not — so a completed+paid appt can be cancelled leaving status/revenue disagreeing. Fix: shared transition guard (reuse getValidStatusTransitions) at the top of each path. (Also consider extracting the reactivation guard, now in 3 places, into one shared helper.)

items.title: Public booking/reschedule max-advance ceiling uses server-local now → valid far-boundary slots rejected for ahead-of-UTC salons
items.notes: Write ceiling built from server-local new Date()+setHours/setDate; the read path (/api/availability) anchors to salon-local day. For UTC+N salons a boundary-day slot the widget just offered is rejected with 'up to N days in advance'. Fix: anchor the ceiling to localDateString(now, business.timezone)+maxDays.

items.title: GET /api/bookings date filter windows on server-local midnight, not the salon timezone
items.notes: parseYmd(date) = server-local midnight vs @db.Timestamptz instants → near-midnight appts land on the wrong day. Sibling v1 route was fixed via combineDateWithTimeZoned; this legacy route wasn't. Low blast radius (no live frontend consumer). Fix: compute day bounds in business.timezone.

items.title: v1 group + recurring booking routes look up the service WITHOUT deletedAt:null → a soft-deleted service can still be booked
items.notes: Every other path filters deletedAt:null; these two don't, so an API-key holder can book a removed service (stale name/price/duration). Business-scoped (not cross-tenant). Fix: add deletedAt:null to both findFirst where clauses (one-liner each).

items.title: Reactivating cancelled/no_show → active never clears cancelledAt/noShowAt or cancellation metadata (stale flags)
items.notes: The reactivation branch sets those fields to `undefined` (Prisma omits → unchanged), and never touches cancellationReasonCode/Initiator/Reason/cancelledBy, so a reactivated appt still reads as a no-show. No current consumer misbehaves (P3). Fix: in the isReactivation branch set them to null (not undefined) in both the action + v1 route.
